main_body: Roofed well: a snow-covered roof on two wooden posts over a stone well with a dark water opening and a stone base
top_band: At x=15 the snow roof (L 249/228/200) covers rows 2-8 and ends in a darker blue edge at row 8. Lower down, the well rim is a light band at rows 16-17 around the dark opening.
evidence: The snow roof reads as a lighter horizontal surface (rows 2-8) over posts and icicles, with a blue-grey edge row at 8 and a shadow row at 9. Below the posts, the well mouth is a real ellipse: a light rim at rows 16-17, a dark water interior at rows 18-22 with a bucket and rope inside, and a front rim at row 23. The stone base below (rows 24-30, 7 rows) is a banded vertical face. Top, front edge and front face are all present, and the inside of the opening is visible from above, so this is a correct 3/4 container.

style.evidence: The snow has about 5 steps (249, 228, 200, 166, 130) with icicles, and the stone and wood carry several tones each. Dark edge pixels are 0% neutral, so the outlines lean blue or brown instead of black. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, like the well reference. Colours per tile (14) and total colours (24) are somewhat below the references (17-20 per tile, 38-40 total) but still information-rich. It would sit acceptably next to the roofed-well reference.
